title: Madeleine Cake
description: A delicate French cake made with millet flour and flavored with a hint of citrus. Perfect for a special breakfast treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together millet flour, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, softened butter, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared molds and smooth the tops.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the molds for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
